verdict.rationale: Pomelo is a card-issuing and processing API platform, so user-configurable background automations are a fair question for it. However, the evidence documents no automation or workflow feature that users can set up to run on their own. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: a 3DS risk rule that forces a challenge above an amount threshold, stand-in authorization when the customer's services respond slowly, merchant blocking, and webhook notifications. None of these is a general-purpose automation, scheduled job, or background agent capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
